blocks.text: Lamarck believed that when an organism faces changes in its environment, it begins to use some body parts / organs more or disuses some organs. He believed that the organs which are used more frequently are developed and become strong while the organs which are not properly used are deteriorated or become weak. He named such changes in body parts, which occur due to long term use or disuse, as “acquired characters”.

Lamarck believed that the characters acquired during the lifetime of an organism were passed on to the offspring of that organism. When acquired characters are inherited generations to generations, they ultimately cause modifications in organism to better “cope” the changes in the environment.
